limitations: Missing Mode relies on the publisher's archive-level OTB assertion; it is not independent event-level verification.
Both player identities must be publisher-labelled Strong or Confirmed; identity confidence does not establish play mode.
Publisher-supplied Elo values are used with the existing numeric thresholds but are not independently certified as official FIDE ratings for each game.
Games dated before 1970 are excluded until historical rating values can be independently validated.
The overall Gigabase license is CC BY-NC 4.0; a public or commercial Evalis integration requires separate terms.
